name: Everyday memory
note: A small set of saved facts and the questions they should answer. Edit this file to measure how well the assistant finds your own kind of facts: each question lists the ids of the facts that ought to come back for it.

facts.text: Taofik drinks his tea without sugar.
Tea should be left to brew for four minutes.
The dentist is on Mill Road and closes at four on Fridays.
His sister Amina lives in Leeds and visits at Easter.
The car needs its tyres checked before any long drive.
Rent is paid on the first working day of the month.
He is allergic to walnuts, so no walnut bread.
The Monday team meeting starts at half past nine.

questions.ask: how does he take his tea
when does the dentist shut on a Friday
what should I check before a long drive
is there anything he cannot eat
what time is the team meeting
